headline: Intel -26%, Amazon -6.5% pre-market, Nasdaq futures -2%, Brent $117, 10y 4.93%
stance: AI cash burn is now the selloff, and Treasuries are the hedge. Oil at a 6-month high caps how far bonds run.

news.head: Intel -26% pre-market, Q4 guide $15-16bn vs $17.05bn
news.body: Q3 beat: EPS $0.52 vs $0.40, revenue $16.51bn. Q4 EPS guided $0.25 vs $0.43 on PC softness (~5:45am ET).

news.head: Amazon -6.5% pre-market, trailing FCF -$42.4bn
news.body: Q3 EPS $1.89 vs $1.97; revenue $201.94bn, a slight miss. AWS +39%, fastest in 5 years. 2026 capex held at $220bn (~5:45am ET).

news.head: SanDisk -4% pre-market despite guide above consensus
news.body: Q2 revenue guided $12.2-12.6bn vs $12.1bn; EPS $55-57 vs $52.72. Memory had led the chip bid (~4am ET).

news.head: BP Q3 profit $8.46bn, nearly 4x; shares +1.3%
news.body: Refining margins drove it. Energy left London the only gain in Europe (~5am ET).

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: 10y 4.93%, 2y 4.59% (~4am ET), both below Thursday's close. Bonds bid on the tech selloff, not the data.
BoJ held 1.25%, 8-1, and called underlying inflation at target for the first time. ECB held; Lagarde leaves Feb 2027.
Brent $117.17, +2.3%; WTI $103.80 (~5am ET), a 6-month high. Tanker hit near Hormuz Friday; Trump briefed on Iran options.
sections.positioning: Specs extended long 2y Treasuries, 99th %ile for 13 weeks: background. WTI specs moved to extended short, 14th %ile, new this week.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Nasdaq 100 futures -2%, S&P -0.9%, Dow +0.2% (~6am ET). The selloff is AI concentration, not growth fear.
Asia sold the same prints. Kospi -3.5%, Nikkei -2.1% at the close; European chip equipment lower.
Third hyperscaler print this week judged on free cash flow. Beats and raised guides did not protect chips.
sections.positioning: Specs extended long Russell 2000, 100th %ile, and Nasdaq 100, 97th, for 4-5 weeks: background, not news.

single_name.note: New to the screen Wednesday. Insider buy filed Oct 28, trades above its 200-day line, 2.2 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Hyperscaler IG supply reopened Thursday: a triple-A $25bn deal, 40-year at +105bp vs +133bp on the prior 40-year.
IG spreads have not followed equities on cash burn. Stress sits in data-center high yield, wider since June.
sections.positioning: Dealer high-yield bond inventory fell to the 13th %ile of 3 years, down 15 points, new this week.

implications: Hot PCE and 3.4% GDP did not stop the bond rally. Rates are trading tech risk ahead of inflation.
Oil at a 6-month high limits that bond bid. A hot ECI puts December back in charge of the 2y.

watch.head: ECI 8:30
watch.body: Q3 labor costs. Core inflation ran 3.1% y/y in Thursday's release, so a hot wage read reprices December.

watch.head: Midterms Nov 3
watch.body: Oil traders brace for Iran escalation after the vote. CENTCOM briefed Trump on strike options Thursday.

watch.head: Treasury refunding Nov 4
watch.body: Coupon sizes hit the long end the morning after the vote.

watch.head: Payrolls Nov 6, BoE Nov 5
watch.body: October payrolls close a week of central banks and supply.
